The Newark New Jersey-based  company is expected to report a 0.8% increase in revenue to $319 million from $316.6 million a year ago, according to the estimate from one analyst, based on LSEG data.
​LSEG's mean analyst estimate for IDT Corporation is for earnings of 98 cents per share.
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy".
The mean earnings estimate of analysts was unchanged in the last three months. ​
